name: player_resolve_pending_world_collision_contact
description: Player::ResolvePendingWorldCollisionContact prepares the queued world collision, conditionally starts the local-player collision loop sound, and resolves the queued world contact.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player collision/source-cluster pass.

The smoke avoids the local-player sound branch and uses a vertical contact normal so the delegated ResolvePendingCollisionContact path takes its BN-observed early return. The prepared response and full collision response are covered by their dedicated smokes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x424110 shows the wrapper passing worldCollisionQueue.head to Player::PreparePendingWorldCollisionResponse, starting modal loop SFX index 4 at full volume only for lifecycle state 1, and then resolving the same queued world contact.
The native smoke checks that the wrapper applies the prepared response and delegates to the world contact resolver without perturbing the vertical-normal early-return contact.
